camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access and try again.
camera.allInUse: Every connected camera is already used by another sorter. Plug in another camera for this sorter.

scanEngine.phoneCaptureFailed: Phone didn't respond with a photo in time.

sessionLock.message: A sorting session is running on this sorter. Pause scanning to make changes here.

connectionFailed.title: Connection failed
connectionFailed.description: Failed to connect. Make sure no other application is using the device.

serial.bluetoothPermissionBlocked: Bluetooth permission is blocked for this browser. Check your browser's site settings (or chrome://settings/content/bluetoothDevices) to allow Bluetooth, then try again.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost
connectionLost.description: The sorter disconnected unexpectedly. If you're connected over USB, make sure no other application (like the Arduino IDE's Serial Monitor) is using the port, then reconnect.

sensorBlocked.title: Card on a sensor
sensorBlocked.description: Module {{module}}'s sensor sees a card, so the self-test didn't run. Drop the card or clear it by hand, then mark it cleared to rerun the test.
sensorBlocked.dropped: Cards dropped. Mark it cleared to rerun the self-test.
sensorBlocked.stillBlocked: Module {{module}} still sees a card. Clear it, then mark it cleared.
sensorBlocked.noResponse: The sorter didn't respond. Reconnect it and try again.

deviceTestFailed.title: Device test failed
deviceTestFailed.description: Connected but got no response. Try reconnecting.

serial.firmwareOutdatedBanner: Your sorter is running firmware v{{version}}, older than the latest v{{latest}}. Re-upload firmware/main/main.ino to update it.
serial.firmwareOutdatedBannerBluetooth: Your sorter is running firmware v{{version}}, older than the latest v{{latest}}. To update it from the browser, plug the ESP32-S3 in with USB (left port, labeled USB) and connect over USB instead of Bluetooth.
serial.firmwareVersionMissingBanner: Your sorter's firmware doesn't report a version and can't be used to scan. Re-upload the latest firmware/main/main.ino to enable scanning.

update.notUsb: Connect the sorter with a USB cable to update it. Updating doesn't work over Bluetooth.
update.dialogDescription: Flashes the latest firmware to your connected ESP32 over this browser tab. Don't disconnect the device or close this tab while it's in progress.
update.flashing: Flashing, do not disconnect the device…
update.success: Firmware flashed. Disconnect the sorter from your computer, then plug it back in to finish.

serial.deviceResolveFailed: Couldn't identify this sorter. Using the last saved calibration.

deviceInUse.title: Sorter already connected
deviceInUse.description: {{name}} is already connected in another sorter panel. Disconnect it there first.

unidentifiedBoard.title: Older firmware detected
unidentifiedBoard.description: This sorter's firmware doesn't report a serial number, so it will use whatever calibration is set for the current device ({{name}}). Update the firmware so each sorter keeps its own calibration.
unidentifiedBoard.descriptionNoDevice: This sorter's firmware doesn't report a serial number, so it will use whatever calibration is set for the current device. Update the firmware so each sorter keeps its own calibration.

errors.wrongChip: This board is an {{chip}}. The sorter firmware only runs on the ESP32-S3, so nothing was written.
errors.noBootloader: Couldn't reach the board's bootloader. Hold the BOOT button, tap RESET, release BOOT, then try again.
errors.downloadFailed: Couldn't download the firmware. Check your connection and try again.
errors.verifyFailed: The firmware was written, but the board's flash doesn't match it. Unplug the board, plug it back in and flash again.

newBoard.dialogDescription: Installs the sorter firmware on an ESP32-S3 straight from this browser. It works on blank boards and boards running other firmware.
newBoard.hintPort: Plug the board in using its left USB-C port (labeled USB, not UART or COM), then pick it in the browser's port prompt.
newBoard.hintBootMode: If flashing can't start, hold BOOT, tap RESET, release BOOT, and try again.
newBoard.success: Firmware installed. The board has restarted and is ready to connect.

pushBlocked.title: Pusher blocked
pushBlocked.description: A card is on module {{module}}'s platform. Lower its side paddle before moving the pusher.

noCollectionSelected.title: No collection selected
noCollectionSelected.description: Create or select a collection before scanning.

collectionLocked.title: Collection locked
collectionLocked.description: Another org member is currently scanning into this collection.

scanLimitReached.title: Daily scan limit reached
scanLimitReached.description: Upgrade to Business for unlimited scanning.

routingFailed.title: Routing failed
routingFailed.description: No response from sorter for bin {{binNumber}}.

routingFailedCatchAll.title: Routing failed
routingFailedCatchAll.description: No response from sorter for catch-all bin {{binNumber}}.

saveFailed.title: Card not saved
saveFailed.description: {{name}} was sorted but couldn't be saved to the collection. Scanning is paused. Check your connection, then take the card back out and rescan it.

saveFailedUnmatched.title: Unmatched card not saved
saveFailedUnmatched.description: A card went to the catch-all but couldn't be saved to the collection. Scanning is paused. Check your connection before resuming.

jamDetected.title: Card jam detected
jamDetected.description: Card stuck at module {{module}}. Check the sorter and resume.
jamDetected.descriptionWithBin: Card stuck at module {{module}} (heading to bin {{bin}}). Check the sorter and resume.
jamDetected.dropFailed: The sorter didn't respond to the drop command. Clear the card by hand.
jamDetected.notReady: The sorter isn't ready. Reconnect it, or clear the card by hand.
jamDetected.dropped: Cards dropped. Mark the jam cleared to start back up.
jamDetected.stillBlocked: Module {{module}} still sees a card. Clear it, then mark the jam cleared.

jamCleared.title: Jam cleared
jamCleared.description: Scanning and auto-feed are back on.

noCardDetected.title: No card detected
noCardDetected.description: Module 1's sensor doesn't see a card - feed one before scanning.

clearFailed.title: Clear failed
clearFailed.description: Could not send command to the device.

clearTimeout.title: Clear timeout
clearTimeout.description: Device did not respond in time.

deviceCleared.title: Device cleared
deviceCleared.description: All bottom paddles were opened to drop any stuck cards.

pausedTabHidden.title: Scanning paused
pausedTabHidden.description: The scanner tab was hidden, so scanning and auto-feed were paused. The camera preview freezes while the tab isn't visible. Press Resume to continue.

scanStats.emptyState: Scan cards to see their stats.
scanStats.scanRateTrend: Scans per minute over the last 12 minutes

scannerControls.feedTooltip: Advance one card from the hopper into the scanner
scannerControls.startTooltip: Feed the first card and start scanning
scannerControls.autoFeedOnTooltip: Auto-feed on, next card feeds automatically after each scan
scannerControls.autoFeedOffTooltip: Auto-feed off, feed each card manually
scannerControls.setHint: Scanned cards use their printing from this set when one exists.

ocrBetaDialog.title: OCR text matching (beta)
ocrBetaDialog.description: When a scan isn't a confident match, this reads the card's name and set line to find the card or pick the right printing. Confident matches skip it, so scanning speed is unchanged. It's still in beta and can misread text. Turn it back off if it seems to be making matches worse.

phoneCamera.scanDescription: Scan this QR code on your phone, or open the link, so it can be used as this scanner's camera.
phoneCamera.connectedDescription: Your phone is ready. It'll take a photo whenever this scanner needs one.
phoneCamera.qrAlt: QR code to pair a phone camera
phoneCamera.statusError: Couldn't reach the phone. Make sure it's still open on this page, then try again.
phoneCamera.sessionEndedDescription: The scanner disconnected this camera. You can turn off the camera or scan a new QR code to reconnect.

scannerOverlay.dailyLimitReached: Daily scan limit reached. Upgrade to Business for unlimited scanning.
scannerOverlay.connectCamera: Connect the webcam mounted over the sorter, or pair your phone to use as the camera.
scannerOverlay.waitingForPhone: Scan the QR code with your phone to pair it as the camera.
scannerOverlay.phoneReadyNoPhoto: Phone camera ready. It'll take a photo as soon as a card arrives.
scannerOverlay.autoFeedOff: Auto-feed is off, feed cards manually.
scannerOverlay.firmwareVersionMissing: Card sorter firmware doesn't report a version. Re-upload the latest firmware/main/main.ino to enable scanning.
scannerOverlay.noCatchAllBin: No catch-all bin configured, so unmatched cards won't be sorted.
scannerOverlay.paused: Scanner paused. Press Resume to continue.
scannerOverlay.duplicate: Same card scanned. Use Add Again to add it anyway.
scannerOverlay.noMatch: Card not recognized. Try Scan Again or adjust lighting.
scannerOverlay.sensorBlocked: Module {{module}}'s sensor sees a card, so the self-test didn't run.

reasonHints.too_far: The closest card was beyond the match distance limit. If the right card is listed below, the limit may be too strict. If not, the card may not be synced or the photo may be poor.
reasonHints.ambiguous: Two different cards were almost equally close, so neither was picked.
reasonHints.empty_index: No cards are synced for this game and language yet. Run a sync from the admin panel.
reasonHints.no_consensus: Scan attempts disagreed on the card, so none reached the required number of matching results. Check lighting, focus and card movement.
reasonHints.lookup_failed: A card was matched, but its details could not be loaded.

unmatchedCardsPanel.detectionFallback: Corner detection failed, used the static scan region.
unmatchedCardsPanel.ocrMatchedName: Closest card name: {{name}} (similarity {{score}}), but no printing was close enough.
unmatchedCardsPanel.ocrNoName: No card name was close enough to the text read.
unmatchedCardsPanel.identifyDescription: Pick the card in this scan. It's added to the collection with this photo, in the bin it was sorted into.
unmatchedCardsPanel.identifyFailed: Couldn't add the card. Try again.

alphabetPassControl.stopFirst: Stop the scanner before moving to the next letters.

monitorPage.noCardsMatchSearch: No cards match the search query.

repackCompleteDialog.description: Every pack is complete, so scanning is paused. Take the pack out of bin {{bin}} and pick where it's going. Each card is recorded there in the order it was scanned.

binLimitDialog.title: Bin {{number}} is full
binLimitDialog.description: Bin {{number}} has reached its limit of {{limit}} cards, so scanning is paused. Take the cards out, choose where they're going if you want to record it, then continue.

feederEmpty.title: Feeder empty
feederEmpty.description: No cards remaining in the hopper. Add more cards to continue.

feederTimeoutDescription: Feeder did not respond in time.
cameraAccessError: Could not access camera. Please check your device.

staleDeviceDialog.title: Been a while since this org connected
staleDeviceDialog.description: This device's calibration hasn't changed in over 30 days. Run the self-test as-is, or calibrate first to make sure everything still matches the physical hardware.

overview.title: All sorters
overview.description: Every sorter in this organization with the last card it scanned, plus the live camera of each connected one. Click a connected sorter to open it in the scanner.
overview.emptyDescription: Connect a sorter from the scanner to see it here.

renameDialog.title: Rename sorter
renameDialog.description: The name shows on the sorter tabs and on this page.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteConfirm.description: This removes the sorter and everything saved for it: its calibration, bin routes, bin heights, feeder settings and their change history. Scanned cards and collections are kept. If you plug it in again, it shows up as a new, uncalibrated sorter.

hardCapReached.title: Up to {{max}} sorters at a time
hardCapReached.description: Disconnect a sorter before connecting another one.

limitReached.title: More sorters need the Business plan
limitReached.description: The free plan runs one sorter at a time. Disconnect the other sorter, or upgrade to Business in Settings to run several at once.

watchPage.invalidDescription: It may have expired or been revoked. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.

unmatchedRateToast.title: Lots of cards aren't matching
unmatchedRateToast.description: Several of your recent scans didn't match any card. Check your calibration: the scan region, capture delay and match settings for this sorter.
unmatchedRateToast.descriptionWithOcr: Several of your recent scans didn't match any card. Check your calibration: the scan region, capture delay and match settings for this sorter. Turning on OCR can also help find cards by the text printed on them.

onnxRuntimeFailure.title: In-browser card detection stopped working
onnxRuntimeFailure.description: The AI detection engine crashed in this tab. Scans are being matched on the server for now, which is slower and skips corner detection. Reload the page to fix it.

mobileMonitor.noActivity: Nothing scanned yet. Scans show up here as they happen.

move.title: Move {{name}} to Bin {{to}}
move.description: It's in Bin {{from}} now, but after the correction it belongs in Bin {{to}}. Move it, then confirm so the bin counts stay right.
move.descriptionNoBin: After the correction it belongs in Bin {{to}}. Put it there, then confirm so the bin counts stay right.

staysIn.title: {{name}} stays in Bin {{bin}}
staysIn.description: It's already in the right bin, so there's nothing to move.

noBin.title: No bin matches {{name}}
noBin.description: None of your bins take this card, so leave it where it is.

autoClose.countdownMoved_one: Marking it as moved in {{count}} second
autoClose.countdownMoved_other: Marking it as moved in {{count}} seconds

deployPause.title: Update in progress
deployPause.description_one: Mault is being updated, so scanning has been paused to make sure no cards are lost. You can resume now, but scans may fail until the update finishes.
deployPause.description_other: Mault is being updated, so scanning has been paused on {{count}} sorters to make sure no cards are lost. You can resume now, but scans may fail until the update finishes.
